text: Different from me? That's a point. Score out of fifty.
Level one. Warm-up. Three fresh hearts.
Name a day of the week.
Bonus one. Mind reader. Name a pet. Match me.
Level two. Hearts reset. Banned answers count as a match.
Bonus two. Triple lock. Farm animal. Dodge my three.
Cow. Pig. Chicken. Different from all three? Point for you.
Level three. Hearts reset. Filters, and four seconds.
Name a fruit. Not red or yellow.
Name an animal. Starts with B.
Name something blue. Not the sky.
Name a country. Not in Europe.
Name a ball sport. Not football or soccer.
Name something cold. Not ice or snow.
Name a green vegetable. Not broccoli.
Bonus three. Chain reaction. Next one starts with T.
Level four. Hearts reset. Three seconds.
Bonus four. Opposite day. Opposite of big.
Final level. Hearts reset. Two rules at once.
Name a sea animal. Not fish, not whale.
Name a country. Starts with I, not India.
Not red, blue, green or yellow.
Not water, tea, coffee or juice.
Final bonus. Voice only. Name a musical instrument.
That was all fifty. Add up your points.
Forty-six or more: One of a Kind.
